desc:
*This game will NOT run well on low end devices*
✈️ PLANE WRECK 💥
Fly real-size planes and crash them with realistic physics!

Smash into buildings, skid across runways, dive into lakes and watch your plane rip apart piece by piece. The bigger the crash, the more cash you earn.

🛩️ 11 planes, from a tiny prop plane to massive jumbo jets and supersonic jets
💥 Real crash physics: wings snap off, engines burst into flames, buildings collapse
💰 Earn cash from every crash, then buy bigger and faster planes
🎁 Daily rewards: come back every day, and Day 7 is the best
👥 Fly with friends: bring a co-pilot or let people ride along
🌦️ Changing weather: rain, storms, fog and wind
